response.sql: WITH joined AS (SELECT COALESCE(t.ordertypedist, '(missing)') AS mix FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = a.translink), grp AS (SELECT mix, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM joined GROUP BY mix), tot AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM grp), shares AS (SELECT g.mix, g.cnt, g.cnt * 1.0 / tot.total AS share FROM grp g CROSS JOIN tot), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT s.mix, s.cnt, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS above_avg_by FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share ORDER BY above_avg_by DESC;
